method: Independent common/contrast basis algebra with raw correction energies; NumPy only; no production function import.

equations.point_residual: native_scale * (C_p + sign_slot * D_p), sign+ for0..7 and- for8..15

scope: Evaluation common/contrast components are separately recovered only on complete16-hour patches. A final8-hour remainder observes C_last+D_last only. Energies describe forecast corrections, not errors against truth.
interpretation_limits: Monthly sums do not constrain complete-patch contrast directly; the shared readout links this null direction to only the final halfpatch when present.
This explains an identification vulnerability but does not by itself prove the cause of forecast error.
A fixed fitted-head starting point can be poor for fine forecasts even when monthly validation improves. Results do not refute LoRA without this fixed head or all possible output-only adaptation.

def sha(p):
 d=hashlib.sha256()
 with Path(p).open('rb') as f:

panels={s:load(contract['data'][s]['path']) for s in ('train','validation')}
wa,wb=head['weight'][0].astype(np.float64),head['weight'][8].astype(np.float64)
ba,bb=float(head['bias'][0]),float(head['bias'][8]);wc,wd=(wa+wb)/2,(wa-wb)/2;bc,bd=(ba+bb)/2,(ba-bb)/2
weights={'first8_weight_l2':float(np.linalg.norm(wa)),'last8_weight_l2':float(np.linalg.norm(wb)),
 'group_weight_cosine':float(wa@wb/np.linalg.norm(wa)/np.linalg.norm(wb)),
 'common_weight_l2':float(np.linalg.norm(wc)),'contrast_weight_l2':float(np.linalg.norm(wd)),
 'first8_bias':ba,'last8_bias':bb,'common_bias':bc,'contrast_bias':bd,
 'common_with_bias_l2':float(np.linalg.norm(np.r_[wc,bc])),'contrast_with_bias_l2':float(np.linalg.norm(np.r_[wd,bd]))}
checks={}
def check(k,b):checks[k]=bool(b);assert b,k
check('within_group_weights_identical',np.array_equal(head['weight'][:8],np.tile(head['weight'][0],(8,1))) and np.array_equal(head['weight'][8:],np.tile(head['weight'][8],(8,1))))
records=[];designs={};errs=[]
for split,panel in panels.items():
 z=cache[split+'_hidden'].astype(np.float64);ns=cache[split+'_native_scale'].astype(np.float64)
 common=np.einsum('npd,d->np',z,wc)+bc;contrast=np.einsum('npd,d->np',z,wd)+bd
 common*=ns[:,None];contrast*=ns[:,None]
 fc=np.empty((len(z),769));fd=np.empty_like(fc)
 for i,hvalue in enumerate(panel['horizon']):
  h=int(hvalue);p,r=divmod(h,16);s=float(panel['scale'][i]);a=common[i,:p];d=contrast[i,:p]
  rc=np.repeat(common[i],16)[:h];rd=(np.repeat(contrast[i],16)*np.tile(np.r_[np.ones(8),-np.ones(8)],47))[:h];delta=rc+rd
  correction_mean=float(delta.mean()/s);level=correction_mean**2;pattern=float(np.var(delta/s));energy=float(np.mean((delta/s)**2))
  boundary_mean=float((8*contrast[i,p]/h/s) if r==8 else 0)
  check(f'{split}_contrast_boundary_mean_{i}',abs(float(rd.mean()/s)-boundary_mean)<1e-10)
  check(f'{split}_coarse_energy_decomposition_{i}',abs(energy-level-pattern)<1e-9*max(1,energy))
  f=ns[i]/s/h;last=z[i,p] if r else np.zeros(768)
  fc[i,:768]=f*(16*z[i,:p].sum(0)+8*last);fc[i,768]=ns[i]/s
  fd[i,:768]=f*8*last;fd[i,768]=f*8*(r==8)
  reconstructed=float(fc[i]@np.r_[wc,bc]+fd[i]@np.r_[wd,bd])
  errs.append(abs(reconstructed-correction_mean))
  records.append({'split':split,'site':str(panel['site'][i]),'target_id':str(panel['target_id'][i]),'month':str(panel['month'][i]),'horizon':h,
    'correction_normalized_mean':correction_mean,'correction_level_energy':level,'correction_pattern_energy':pattern,'correction_total_energy':energy,
    'common_normalized_month_mean':float(rc.mean()/s),'contrast_normalized_month_mean':boundary_mean,
    'contrast_total_energy':float(np.mean((rd/s)**2)),'contrast_month_mean_energy':boundary_mean**2,
    'fullpatch_common_level_energy':float((a.mean()/s)**2),'fullpatch_common_pattern_energy':float(np.var(a/s)),
    'fullpatch_contrast_energy':float(np.mean((d/s)**2)),
    'fullpatch_correction_pattern_energy':float(np.var(a/s)+np.mean((d/s)**2)),
    'fullpatch_contrast_fraction_of_pattern':float(np.mean((d/s)**2)/(np.var(a/s)+np.mean((d/s)**2))) if np.var(a/s)+np.mean((d/s)**2)>0 else 0})
 designs[split]=(fc,fd)
check('monthly_design_decomposition',max(errs)<1e-10)
fc,fd=designs['train'];joint=np.concatenate([fc,fd],1)
u,sv,vt=np.linalg.svd(fc,full_matrices=False);sj=np.linalg.svd(joint,compute_uv=False)
tol=float(max(joint.shape)*np.finfo(float).eps*sj[0]);rc=int(np.sum(sv>tol));rj=int(np.sum(sj>tol))
conditional=fd-u[:,:rc]@(u[:,:rc].T@fd);sc=np.linalg.svd(conditional,compute_uv=False)
rank={'common_rank':rc,'joint_rank':rj,'contrast_rank_conditional_on_common':int(np.sum(sc>tol)),'absolute_rank_tolerance':tol,
      'common_design_frobenius_norm':float(np.linalg.norm(fc)),'contrast_design_frobenius_norm':float(np.linalg.norm(fd)),
      'contrast_to_common_feature_norm_ratio':float(np.linalg.norm(fd)/np.linalg.norm(fc)),
      'conditional_contrast_frobenius_norm':float(np.linalg.norm(conditional)),
      'common_singular_values':sv.tolist(),'joint_singular_values':sj.tolist(),'conditional_contrast_singular_values':sc.tolist(),
      'fullpatch_only_rows':int(np.sum(panels['train']['horizon']%16==0)),
      'halfpatch_boundary_rows':int(np.sum(panels['train']['horizon']%16==8))}
# Evaluation diagnosis uses forecasts and their public input metadata only, never the target archive.
plateau_max=0;energy_identity=[]
for i,hvalue in enumerate(forecast['horizon']):
 h=int(hvalue);p=h//16;s=float(forecast['scale'][i]);base=forecast['F0'][i,:h].astype(np.float64);pred=forecast['FROZEN_HEAD'][i,:h].astype(np.float64)
 delta=pred-base;full=delta[:16*p].reshape(p,16);a=full[:,:8].mean(1);b=full[:,8:].mean(1);c=(a+b)/2;d=(a-b)/2
 within=float(max(np.max(abs(full[:,:8]-a[:,None])),np.max(abs(full[:,8:]-b[:,None])))/s);plateau_max=max(plateau_max,within)
 residual_pattern=float(np.var(delta/s));base_pattern=float(np.var(base/s));head_pattern=float(np.var(pred/s));cross=float(2*np.mean((base-base.mean())*(delta-delta.mean()))/s**2)
 energy_identity.append(abs(head_pattern-base_pattern-residual_pattern-cross))
 records.append({'split':'evaluation_predictions_only','site':str(forecast['site'][i]),'target_id':str(forecast['target_id'][i]),'month':str(forecast['month'][i]),'horizon':h,
  'correction_normalized_mean':float(delta.mean()/s),'correction_level_energy':float((delta.mean()/s)**2),
  'correction_pattern_energy':residual_pattern,'correction_total_energy':float(np.mean((delta/s)**2)),
  'fullpatch_common_level_energy':float((c.mean()/s)**2),'fullpatch_common_pattern_energy':float(np.var(c/s)),
  'fullpatch_contrast_energy':float(np.mean((d/s)**2)),'fullpatch_correction_pattern_energy':float(np.var(c/s)+np.mean((d/s)**2)),
  'fullpatch_contrast_fraction_of_pattern':float(np.mean((d/s)**2)/(np.var(c/s)+np.mean((d/s)**2))) if np.var(c/s)+np.mean((d/s)**2)>0 else 0,
  'base_forecast_pattern_energy':base_pattern,'head_forecast_pattern_energy':head_pattern,'base_correction_pattern_cross_term':cross,
  'within8_plateau_max_normalized':within,'last_partial_patch_hours':h%16,
  'boundary_common_contrast_separately_identified':h%16==0})
check('evaluation_forecast_pattern_energy_identity',max(energy_identity)<1e-9)
check('evaluation_within8_roundoff_only',plateau_max<1e-5)
keys=['correction_level_energy','correction_pattern_energy','correction_total_energy','fullpatch_common_level_energy','fullpatch_common_pattern_energy','fullpatch_contrast_energy','fullpatch_correction_pattern_energy']
def aggregate(rows):
 sites={}
 for site in sorted(set(r['site'] for r in rows)):
  targets=[]
  sr=[r for r in rows if r['site']==site]
  for target in sorted(set(r['target_id'] for r in sr)):
   tr=[r for r in sr if r['target_id']==target]
   targets.append({k:float(np.mean([r[k] for r in tr])) for k in keys})
  metric={k:float(np.mean([r[k] for r in targets])) for k in keys}
  metric['fullpatch_contrast_fraction_of_pattern']=metric['fullpatch_contrast_energy']/metric['fullpatch_correction_pattern_energy']
  metric['pattern_to_level_correction_energy_ratio']=metric['correction_pattern_energy']/metric['correction_level_energy'] if metric['correction_level_energy'] else None
  sites[site]=metric
 return sites
summary={split:aggregate([r for r in records if r['split']==split]) for split in ('train','validation','evaluation_predictions_only')}
check('inputs_unchanged',all(sha(p)==h for p,h in before.items()))

 'contract_sha256':sha(run/'study_contract.json'),'input_hashes_before_after':before,'checks':checks,'check_count':len(checks),
 'method':'Independent common/contrast basis algebra with raw correction energies; NumPy only; no production function import.',
 'evaluation_truth_loaded':False,'evaluation_inputs_loaded':False,'evaluation_forecasts_loaded':True,'gpu_used':False,'threads':2,
